headerDisplay: Full HomeKit support for UniFi Access devices. See the [homebridge-unifi-access](https://github.com/hjdhjd/homebridge-unifi-access) developer page for detailed documentation.
footerDisplay: See the [homebridge-unifi-access developer page](https://github.com/hjdhjd/homebridge-unifi-access) for detailed documentation, including [Feature Options](https://github.com/hjdhjd/homebridge-unifi-access/blob/main/docs/FeatureOptions.md) and [MQTT](https://github.com/hjdhjd/homebridge-unifi-access/blob/main/docs/MQTT.md).

address.title: Controller Address
address.description: Hostname or IP address of your UniFi Access controller.

name.title: Controller Name
name.description: Name for this UniFi Access controller to be used for logging purposes. Default: Defined by the controller.

password.title: Controller Password
password.description: UniFi Access password for this controller. Credentials are what bring your doors and devices into HomeKit. Creating a homebridge-specific local user is strongly encouraged for security and sanity.

access.title: Access API Token
access.placeholder: e.g. an Access console API token
access.description: API token generated in the UniFi Access console, under Settings > General. A token reaches the official Access API and can be used on its own or alongside a local user's credentials.

username.title: Controller Username
username.description: UniFi Access username for this controller. Credentials are what bring your doors and devices into HomeKit. Creating a homebridge-specific local user is strongly encouraged for security and sanity.

verifyTls.title: Verify TLS Certificates
verifyTls.description: Require this controller to present TLS certificates that verify. Verification covers the console's own connection and, when an API token is configured, the Access developer API on port 12445, which presents a certificate of its own: a certificate installed on the console does not reach it, so a token identity needs a trusted certificate installed on the developer port as well. Leave this off for a controller presenting the self-signed certificates it ships with. Default: false.

name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: Name to use for Homebridge logging purposes. Default: UniFi Access.

items.title: Feature Option
items.description: Enter only one option per entry. See the plugin documentation for the complete list of available options or use the feature options webUI tab above.
Provide the address of each of your UniFi Access controllers, along with a local user's login, an API token, or both.
These settings are optional. The defaults work well for almost everyone.

Feature options allow you to further customize the behavior of this plugin such as the ability to show or hide devices. You can use the the feature options tab above (recommended) to customize these settings or enter them manually below.
These settings should be rarely used or needed by most people. Use these with caution.
